newsitem.title: CHINA: China economist sees 10 pct growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China economist sees 10 pct growth in 1997.

text.p: China's economic growth will be about 10 percent with inflation around five percent this year, the official Xinhua news agency on Thursday quoted a senior economist as saying.
Xinhua quoted Qiu Xiaohua, chief economist of the State Statistical Bureau, as making the forecast at a seminar on the economy.
Qiu had recently put economic growth at 9.0 percent and inflation at less than six percent.
Qiu told the seminar that increasing international trade was a key factor in the strong economic performance, Xinhua said.
China recorded growth of 9.7 percent last year with retail price inflation of 6.1 percent.
Some economists have said that inflation could be as low as three to four percent this year. It was a moderate 2.6 percent in the first quarter.
